messages.subject: Aiga | Confidential International Executive Profile | Energy, Infrastructure, ESG & Government Relations
messages.body:
Dear Ms. Arste-Avotina,

Your leadership of Amrop Baltics and your executive-search work across Energy & Infrastructure, Government & Public Sector, Financial Services and Industrial markets align closely with my background and next career move.

I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My responsibilities span government and regulatory relations, ESG and social performance, corporate and external affairs, stakeholder strategy, compliance coordination and executive advisory for a major international mining operation. I also support external engagement around large-scale renewable-energy and capital-investment initiatives.

Across 12+ years, I have worked in multinational mining, regulated financial services and commercial operations. I am pursuing Director, Senior Director, Head, VP-track and country-facing mandates across Energy & Infrastructure, Corporate Affairs, Government Relations, ESG, Strategic Partnerships and General Management.

I am internationally mobile and open to Baltic, Nordic, wider European and expatriate assignments. I have attached an executive-search CV prepared for Amrop Baltics and would welcome confidential consideration for relevant current or upcoming mandates.

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department | AGM Inc.
